summary: Toyota Auto Finance Receivables LLC filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of asset-backed notes by Toyota Auto Receivables 2026-B Owner Trust. On April 21, 2026, the trust issued six tranches of notes totaling $1.9 billion (Class A-1 $400.6M, A-2a $537.9M, A-2b $134.4M, A-3 $672.3M, A-4 $107.3M, Class B $47.5M) secured by motor vehicle retail installment sales contracts. This is an ordinary ABS securitization, not a corporate special situation. There are no deal terms such as price-per-share or premiums. The filing merely discloses entry into material definitive agreements (purchase, servicing, trust agreements) and is routine for the structured finance issuer.
